svg.font-family: 'Comic Sans MS', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Comic Neue', 'Bradley Hand', casual, sans-serif
svg.title: PAM4 SerDes: the whole link
svg.desc: Top level pam4_serdes. Transmit side: reference clock, refclk_buf, tx_pll (437.5 MHz x 32 = 14 GHz), then tx_top with its clock generator, PRBS source, two serializer paths, six pre-drivers, the PAM4 driver and tx_bias. The 28 GBd PAM4 output leaves on txp / txn, crosses a channel that is not on the chip, and comes back on rx_p / rx_n. Receive side: rx_top with the analog front end, the decision block, two retimers and two deserializer paths giving two 32-bit words, clocked by rx_cdr through rx_clkgen.

g.text: 56 Gb/s = 28 GBd x 2 bits per symbol. Every block is a behavioural model; a testbench supplies the channel.
frequency lock, then tracks the data
CMOS on one side, CML on the other
